integrity: The existence proof is a compact-convex face argument plus the classical extreme-measure characterization of ergodicity. The negative part is an explicit complete classification of invariant measures on a two-component circle trajectory space. No numerical experiment or finite search is used as evidence for an infinite claim.
limitations: Applies to extreme points of the affine image of shift-invariant trajectory-space measures; it does not prove that every invariant measure ergodic in the strong-backward-invariance sense is extreme, nor characterize all possible almost-everywhere time-average values. The counterexample intentionally does not assume the switching axiom, which is also absent from the source theorem being corrected.
title: Extremality guarantees an ergodic lift, not an ergodic chosen lift
